op.schema: loading standard candidates for the design

schema.head: Standard ontology candidates
schema.hint: For the terms this design newly mints, here are matching terms from famous standards (suggestions only — adopt them in the dataset after ingest).

picker.placeholder: Search in plain English (e.g. temperature, crystal structure)
picker.none: Nothing found. Try a common English word (temperature, density, sample) — or just leave it as is; search and citation work without it.

adopt.noTerms: No own terms to align yet (they appear once the words settle after ingest).

banner.title: Align your words to the world's standard words
banner.sub: Link this data's own words to commonly used standard terms. Once aligned, your data connects automatically with others, and external tools and AI understand it directly. Aligning is optional — search and citation work either way.

state.suggest: Suggested (found automatically in the standards list)
state.none: No matching standard found (fine to leave as is)

why.head: Why align?
why.p1: Connect to other data with the same meaning, automatically
why.p2: External tools and AI understand it directly
why.p3: Searchable by the world's common terms too

detected.head: Standard words already in use (found automatically)
detected.sub: Well-known standard words already used inside the data.

caution: Candidates are matched mechanically from the standards list — no AI is involved. Similar words can still mean different things, so read them and only what you align stays aligned.
